sentences.en: My name is Joshua Hunt and I'm a contributor to the New York Times Magazine.
sentences.zh: 我是约书亚·亨特，《纽约时报杂志》的撰稿人。

sentences.en: This week's Sunday Read is my story for the magazine about the history and enduring cultural influence of the Criterion Collection,
sentences.zh: 本周的“星期日阅读”是我为该杂志撰写的关于标准收藏（Criterion Collection）历史及其持久文化影响力的报道，

sentences.en: a home video company that's been around for 40 years.
sentences.zh: 这是一家已经存在了40年的家庭录像公司。

sentences.en: It started out selling Laserdiscs in the early 1980s.
sentences.zh: 它在20世纪80年代初以销售激光影碟起家。

sentences.en: These days, its mission, to highlight what it calls important classic and contemporary films from around the world, is mostly carried out through sales of DVD and Blu-ray discs.
sentences.zh: 如今，它的使命是突显它所谓的来自世界各地的、重要的经典与当代电影，这一使命主要通过DVD和蓝光光盘的销售来完成。

sentences.en: Criterion not only survived all these technological shifts in the business of how movies get made and distributed, but it's prospered.
sentences.zh: 标准收藏不仅在电影制作和发行商业模式的所有这些技术变革中存活了下来，而且还蓬勃发展。

sentences.en: Five years ago, it launched a streaming service of its own.
sentences.zh: 五年前，它推出了自己的流媒体服务。

sentences.en: But in an age when our tastes are so algorithmically determined,
sentences.zh: 但在一个我们的品味由算法深度决定的时代，

sentences.en: the Criterion Channel stands out for its reliance on human curation.
sentences.zh: 标准收藏频道凭借对人工策展的依赖而脱颖而出。

sentences.en: Every film is handpicked.
sentences.zh: 每一部电影都是人工挑选的。

sentences.en: Nothing gets recommended based on what others are watching or what you've watched before.
sentences.zh: 没有任何推荐是基于别人正在看什么或者你以前看过了什么。

sentences.en: I first came across Criterion in the late 90s when I became obsessed with its DVD release of Akira Kurosawa's Seven Samurai.
sentences.zh: 我第一次接触标准收藏是在90年代末，当时我沉迷于它发行的黑泽明的DVD版《七武士》。

sentences.en: Eventually, I bought every Kurosawa film Criterion released on DVD.
sentences.zh: 最终，我买下了标准收藏在DVD上发行的每一部黑泽明电影。

sentences.en: And, over time, I developed this trust in the Criterion brand, where I would occasionally buy movies that I knew nothing about.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，我对标准收藏这个品牌建立了一种信任，有时我会购买一些我一无所知的电影。

sentences.en: I think it's how a lot of people's relationship with Criterion goes.
sentences.zh: 我想这也是很多人的标准收藏初体验。

sentences.en: It starts with movies they know, but eventually, they're taking a leap of faith based on the brand and not the filmmaker.
sentences.zh: 它从他们知道的电影开始，但最终，他们会基于这个品牌而不是电影导演来凭信仰盲买。

sentences.en: Criterion is who they trust to tell them what is good cinema.
sentences.zh: 标准收藏是他们信任的、能告诉他们什么是优秀电影的向导。

sentences.en: So, here's my article.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是我的文章。

sentences.en: Sure, it won an Oscar, but is it Criterion?
sentences.zh: 当然，它赢得了奥斯卡，但它是标准收藏级别的电影吗？

sentences.en: In October 2022, amid a flurry of media appearances promoting their film Tar, the director Todd Field and the star Kate Blanchett made time to visit a cramped closet in Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 2022年10月，在为他们的电影《塔尔》展开的一系列紧密宣传活动期间，导演托德·菲尔德和主演凯特·布兰切特抽出时间参观了曼哈顿的一个狭小储藏室。

sentences.en: This closet, which has become a sacred space for movie buffs, was once a disused bathroom at the headquarters of the Criterion Collection, a 40-year-old company dedicated to
sentences.zh: 这个储藏室如今已成为影迷心中的圣地，它曾经是标准收藏总部的一个废弃浴室。标准收藏是一家拥有40年历史的公司，致力于

sentences.en: gathering the greatest films from around the world and making high-quality editions available to the public on DVD and Blu-ray and, more recently, through its streaming service,
sentences.zh: 搜集来自世界各地的最伟大电影，并通过DVD、蓝光光盘以及最近的流媒体服务将其高品质版本公之于众，

sentences.en: the Criterion Channel.
sentences.zh: 即标准收藏频道。

sentences.en: Today, Criterion uses the closet as its stockroom, housing films by some 600 directors from more than 50 countries, a catalogue so synonymous with cinematic achievement
sentences.zh: 今天，标准收藏将这个储藏室用作其仓库，里面存放着来自50多个国家的约600位导演的电影，这个目录与电影成就紧密相连，

sentences.en: that it has come to function as a kind of film hall of fame.
sentences.zh: 以至于它已经成了一种电影名人堂。

sentences.en: Over four decades, through a combination of luck, obsession, and good taste, this 55-person company has become the arbiter of what makes a great movie,
sentences.zh: 在过去的四家里，通过运气、痴迷和好品味的结合，这家只有55人的公司成为了什么才是伟大电影的仲裁者，

sentences.en: more so than any Hollywood studio or awards ceremony.
sentences.zh: 这一点甚至超过了任何好莱坞制片厂或颁奖典礼。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, the Criterion closet has also served as the backdrop for a popular online video series in which actors and filmmakers,
sentences.zh: 十多年来，标准收藏储藏室也一直是一个热门网络视频系列的背景，演员和电影制片人们

sentences.en: Nathan Lane, Aubrey Plaza, and Ethan Hawke among them, pick out their favorite Criterion titles to take home.
sentences.zh: 包括内森·连恩、奥布瑞·普拉扎和伊桑·霍克，会在里面挑选他们最喜欢的标准收藏影片带回家。

sentences.en: Like other celebrity guests in the Closet Picks series,
sentences.zh: 就像“储藏室挑选”系列中的其他名人嘉宾一样，

sentences.en: Field and Blanchett plucked their selections from the neatly ordered shelves and used them as conduits for spontaneous bursts of evangelism.
sentences.zh: 菲尔德和布兰切特从整齐排列的书架上随手抽选，并将它们作为宣泄狂热激情的渠道。

sentences.en: Field praised Raymond Bernard's Wooden Crosses as one of the greatest war movies ever made.
sentences.zh: 菲尔德称赞雷蒙·贝尔纳的《木十字架》是有史以来最伟大的战争电影之一。

sentences.en: While Blanchett singled out Larissa Shepetko's The Ascent as something that has to be owned by every single human in the world.
sentences.zh: 而布兰切特则特别指出拉里萨·谢佩特科的《登攀》是世界上每一个人都必须拥有的东西。

sentences.en: Neither bothered to mention Tar, the film they were otherwise working so hard to promote.
sentences.zh: 两人都没有费心去提及《塔尔》——那部他们正费尽心思宣传的电影。

sentences.en: Inside the closet, even the biggest stars are reduced to a state of childlike fandom.
sentences.zh: 在储藏室里，即使是最大牌的明星也会变成孩子般的狂热影迷。

sentences.en: There's no cynicism in the closet,
sentences.zh: 储藏室里没有愤世嫉俗，

sentences.en: Field told me.
sentences.zh: 菲尔德告诉我。

sentences.en: It's all love.
sentences.zh: 这里只有热爱。

sentences.en: It's all about why people do what they do and how powerful movies are for us.
sentences.zh: 这全关于人们为什么要做他们所做的事，以及电影对我们而言有多么强大。

sentences.en: Each year,
sentences.zh: 每年，

sentences.en: Criterion selects 50 or 60 new entrants to add to its catalog, which now includes 1,650 filMs.
sentences.zh: 标准收藏都会挑选50或60部新作品加入其目录，该目录现在已包含1,650部电影。

sentences.en: Some Hollywood directors campaign relentlessly for their films or their favorite films from the past to make the liSt.
sentences.zh: 一些好莱坞导演为了让自己的电影或他们过去喜爱的电影进入这个名单而不懈地游说。

sentences.en: For legions of film fans,
sentences.zh: 对于广大影迷而言，

sentences.en: Criterion is akin to the Louvre, but with an aura of hip, the writer and director Josh Safdie told me in an email.
sentences.zh: 标准收藏就像是卢浮宫，但带着一种前卫的气质，作家兼导演乔希·萨夫迪在电子邮件中对我说。

sentences.en: When Safdie's film, Uncut Gems, which he directed with his brother, Benny, entered the Criterion collection with the spine number 1101,
sentences.zh: 当萨夫迪与他的兄弟本尼共同执导的电影《原钻》以脊椎编号1101加入标准收藏时，

sentences.en: he said they couldn't help feeling as if they had snuck into the museum that they had admired for so long.
sentences.zh: 他说他们忍不住觉得自己仿佛偷偷溜进了这座他们钦佩已久的博物馆。

sentences.en: Being a part of the collection is something that we're both incredibly proud of,
sentences.zh: 能够成为这个收藏系列的一部分是我们俩都感到无比骄傲的事情，

sentences.en: Safdie told me.
sentences.zh: 萨夫迪告诉我。

sentences.en: It may sound corny, but it was more meaningful than awards.
sentences.zh: 这听起来可能有点老套，但它比奖项更有意义。

sentences.en: Criterion's commitment to film and filmmakers has helped the company, which began in the 1980s by releasing films on VHS and Laserdisc, a precursor to DVDs
sentences.zh: 标准收藏对电影和电影人的执着帮助这家公司保持了相关性与盈利能力。该公司始于20世纪80年代，通过发行VHS录像带和激光影碟起家（激光影碟是DVD的前身，

sentences.en: with a comparatively enormous diameter of 12 inches, to stay relevant and profitable through a series of tech revolutions that have upended the industry.
sentences.zh: 直径相对巨大，达到12英寸），经历了一系列颠覆整个行业的科技革命后依然屹立不倒。

sentences.en: While studios and streaming services chase audiences by producing endless sequels and spinoffs, trying to wring fresh content from old ideas,
sentences.zh: 当各大制片厂和流媒体服务通过制作无数续集和衍生作品、试图从旧创意中榨取新鲜内容来追逐观众时，

sentences.en: Criterion has built a brand that audiences trust to lead them, even to the most obscure corners of the film universe.
sentences.zh: 标准收藏建立了一个让观众信任的品牌，引导他们去探索电影世界中最隐秘的角落。

sentences.en: Criterion's success in marketing beautiful, strange, complex movies is the road not taken by most of Hollywood.
sentences.zh: 标准收藏在营销美丽、奇异、复杂的电影方面的成功，是好莱坞大多数同行没有走过的一条路。

sentences.en: A steadfast belief in the value of human creativity and curation over the output of any algorithm.
sentences.zh: 坚定不移地相信人类创造力和策展的价值，胜过任何算法的产物。

sentences.en: One day in the spring of 1992, a year after taking over as director of Criterion,
sentences.zh: 1992年春天的某一天，在接任标准收藏导演一年后，

sentences.en: Michael Nash was sitting in his beachfront office in Santa Monica when he got an unexpected phone call.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·纳什正坐在圣莫尼卡海滩边的办公室里，突然接到了一个意想不到的电话。

sentences.en: Like many people who work for years in Hollywood,
sentences.zh: 就像许多在好莱坞工作多年的人一样，

sentences.en: Nash has a tendency to describe events as if he were reading lines from a screenplay.
sentences.zh: 纳什有一种倾向，喜欢用仿佛在读电影剧本台词的方式来描述发生的事件。

sentences.en: You're sitting in the office, and on the desk there's the old-style intercom, he told me.
sentences.zh: 你坐在办公室里，桌上放着老式的对讲机，他告诉我。

sentences.en: The operator takes an incoming call, and then it's like,
sentences.zh: 接线员转接了进来的电话，然后就像是，

sentences.en: Michael Nash, David Bowie on line four.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·纳什，四号线是大卫·鲍伊。

sentences.en: Bowie was calling about Nicholas Roeg's 1976 film,
sentences.zh: 鲍伊打来电话是关于尼古拉斯·罗伊格1976年的电影，

sentences.en: The Man Who Fell to Earth, in which Bowie starred as an alien visitor who masquerades as human and succumbs to the human condition.
sentences.zh: 《天外来客》，鲍伊在片中饰演一个伪装成人类的外星访客，最终向人类的生存状态妥协。

sentences.en: Nash remembered seeing the movie years earlier and finding it amazing but difficult to understand.
sentences.zh: 纳什记得几年前看过这部电影，觉得它很神奇但又很难懂。

sentences.en: I was totally confused, he said.
sentences.zh: 我完全被搞糊涂了，他说。

sentences.en: The reason audiences couldn't make sense of it, Bowie explained, was that the theatrical release for The Man Who Fell to Earth
sentences.zh: 鲍伊解释说，观众之所以看不懂这部电影，是因为《天外来客》的院线发行版

sentences.en: was missing 18 minutes of film that was cut by the distributor.
sentences.zh: 删掉了被发行商剪掉的18分钟电影。

sentences.en: It got butchered, Nash told me.
sentences.zh: 它被彻底糟蹋了，纳什告诉我。

sentences.en: Years later, its star was hoping that Criterion might consider releasing Roeg's original cut of the film on Laserdisc.
sentences.zh: 多年后，该片的主演希望标准收藏能考虑在激光影碟上发行罗伊格的电影原剪版。

sentences.en: Criterion was founded nearly a decade earlier by the CD-ROM pioneer Bob Stein.
sentences.zh: 标准收藏是由CD-ROM先驱鲍勃·斯坦在近十年前创立的。

sentences.en: Along with his wife, Aline Stein, and a former Warner Brothers executive named Roger Smith, to explore the technological possibilities of the Laserdisc.
sentences.zh: 他与妻子阿琳·斯坦以及前华纳兄弟高管罗杰·史密斯一起，旨在探索激光影碟的技术可能性。

sentences.en: Then a novel format that could accommodate multiple audio tracks and allowed viewers to stop on any frame of a film with no image distortion.
sentences.zh: 在当时这是一种新颖的格式，可以容纳多条音轨，并允许观众在电影的任意一帧暂停而没有图像失真。

sentences.en: Criterion would track down the original negative or best-surviving preprint version, then hire technicians to scan the film, remove blemishes when possible,
sentences.zh: 标准收藏会追溯到原始底片或现存最好的预印本版本，然后聘请技术人员扫描电影，尽可能地去除瑕疵，

sentences.en: and correct colors that may have faded or turned pink over time.
sentences.zh: 并校正随时间推移而褪色或变成粉红色的色彩。

sentences.en: The vision, says Rebecca Ottek, who worked as head of design at Criterion from 1991 to 1994, was getting people access to all these great filMs.
sentences.zh: 1991年至1994年担任标准收藏设计主管的丽贝卡·奥特克说，他们的愿景是让人们接触到所有这些伟大的电影。

sentences.en: Before the emergence of the home video market in the late 1970s,
sentences.zh: 在20世纪70年代末家庭视频市场出现之前，

sentences.en: Hollywood studios had little use for films whose theatrical runs had concluded.
sentences.zh: 好莱坞制片厂对已经结束院线上映的电影几乎没有什么需求。

sentences.en: They ceased to be commodities and were often destroyed or transferred to public archives where they remained vulnerable to fire, deterioration, and discoloration.
sentences.zh: 它们不再是商品，往往被销毁或转移到公共档案中，在那里它们极易受到火灾、变质和褪色的侵害。

sentences.en: Nonprofits led the nascent movement to preserve and restore motion pictures until Criterion helped create a market for them.
sentences.zh: 非营利组织引领了保护和修复电影的萌芽运动，直到标准收藏帮它们创造了一个市场。

sentences.en: The company's first release was a Laserdisc edition of Citizen Kane that included supplementary materials like a video essay
sentences.zh: 公司的第一部作品是《公民凯恩》的激光影碟版本，其中包含了诸如视频小品等补充材料，

sentences.en: and extensive liner notes on the provenance of the negative from which the restoration was made.
sentences.zh: 以及关于修复所依据的底片来源的大量说明文字。

sentences.en: Next came King Kong, which featured the first-ever audio commentary track, inspired as an afterthought by the stories that the film scholar Ronald Haver
sentences.zh: 接下来是《金刚》，它具有史上的第一条音频评论音轨，灵感来自电影学者罗纳德·哈弗

sentences.en: told while supervising the tedious process of transferring the film from celluloid.
sentences.zh: 在监督将电影从赛璐珞胶片转移的繁琐过程中所讲述的故事的一个突发奇想。

sentences.en: The novelty of the Laserdisc meant licensing fees cost virtually nothing compared with the dominant VHS tape format.
sentences.zh: 激光影碟的新颖性意味着，与占主导地位的VHS录像带格式相比，授权费用几乎为零。

sentences.en: Acquiring the rights to Citizen Kane and King Kong from RKO Pictures cost Criterion around $10,000.
sentences.zh: 从RKO电影公司获得《公民凯恩》和《金刚》的版权花费了标准收藏大约1万美元。

sentences.en: Securing the best surviving print of a film often required assiduous detective work.
sentences.zh: 获取一部电影现存最好的拷贝往往需要进行坚持不懈的侦探工作。

sentences.en: The original negative for Dr. Strangelove was lost, says Morgan Holly, who served as an in-house producer for the Criterion Laserdisc of Stanley Kubrick's
sentences.zh: 《奇爱博士》的原始底片丢失了，摩根·霍利说道，他曾担任斯坦利·库布里克这部

sentences.en: 1964 Cold War satire.
sentences.zh: 1964年冷战讽刺喜剧的标准收藏激光影碟的内部制片人。

sentences.en: There was one print that was struck from the original negative that was somewhere in the world.
sentences.zh: 世界上某处存有一个由原始底片压印出来的拷贝。

sentences.en: One of Criterion's editors,
sentences.zh: 标准收藏的一位编辑，

sentences.en: Maria Palazzola, tracked it down only to learn that on its journey to the United States, it took a detour through Japan where strict anti-pornography laws
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚·帕拉佐拉追踪到了它，却得知在它运往美国的旅途中，曾绕道日本，而当地严格的反色情法律

sentences.en: prompted customs officials to order a test screening that would almost certainly have degraded or destroyed Kubrick's sole personal print of the film.
sentences.zh: 促使海关官员下令进行试映，这几乎肯定会使库布里克仅存的个人电影拷贝退化或毁坏。

sentences.en: It was this battle, Holly told me, but in the end, they persuaded the Japanese authorities to send the print on its way unscreened and unscathed.
sentences.zh: 霍利告诉我，就是经过这样一番较量，他们最终说服了日本当局将拷贝未加试映、完好无损地放行。

sentences.en: Criterion sought to restore films not only to pristine condition, but also with the intent of the filmmaker in mind.
